title: Research MiniMax H3 on the local bench before any engine bump
description: H3 is a packed audio+video DiT, supported in ComfyUI core from v0.30.0 (nodes MiniMaxH3ImageToVideo / MiniMaxH3ReferenceToVideo / EmptyMiniMaxH3LatentAV / MiniMaxH3SigmaShift, plus a minimax CLIPLoader type). The bench at G:/ComfyUi was bumped 0.29.2 -> 0.30.2 on 2026-08-05 and the nodes register clean. The open question is not wiring, it is feasibility: weights are at Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3 and the smallest usable set is 53.9 GB (DiT pruned_fp8_scaled 20.96 + qwen3vl_32b int8_convrot 27.14 + video VAE 5.21 + audio VAE 0.61), against 53.7 GB free on G: and 16 GB VRAM on the RTX 4060 Ti. Answer runnability first on the bench (or a Pod), and only then decide whether to bump the engine off its 0.29.2 pin and wire H3 as a model.
acceptance: A yes/no on whether H3 runs at all on the 4060 Ti 16 GB, measured not guessed - or a Pod run standing in for it
One working bench workflow that produces video AND audio from H3, saved under the task research folder
The chosen weight variant recorded with its reason (fp8 vs int8_convrot vs nvfp4, pruned vs full)
A go/no-go on bumping the engine from 0.29.2 to 0.30.x, with the custom-node pairing risk checked
If no-go for local, the finding is written down so the next agent does not re-derive it
